description: This file contains functions related to exporting PyTorch models to ONNX format, including extracting registered ONNX-compatible operators and creating a decomposition table for unsupported operations during export.

methods.name: list[_registration.TorchOp] get_onnx_implemented_overloads( registry: _registration.ONNXRegistry, )
methods.description: Returns a list of ONNX-supported PyTorch operator overloads from the provided Registry.

methods.name: dict[_registration.TorchOp,Callable] create_onnx_friendly_decomposition_table( onnx_registered_ops: set[_registration.TorchOp], )
methods.description: Creates a mapping from unsupported operator overloads to their decomposition functions, excluding those with existing ONNX symbolic implementations.
